# Pass rate does not see erosion

## Check

Compare a maintainer's merge decision with the pass rate on the same changes.

## Learn

- [A talk on reward](https://example.com/reward?t=723): why the reward cannot see design.

## Evidence for

- 2026-09-30: a benchmark scored fewer changes as mergeable than as passing.

## Evidence against

- 2026-09-30: a vendor found agent and human changes reverted at the same rate.
